name: GENP
recent: Genting Plantations 在 2026 年 11 月 25 日公布截至 2026 年 9 月 30 日的季度业绩，第三季盈利按年增长 8%。公司近期持续进行股份回购，并有多项大股东（KWAP、EPF）的持股变动申报。
notable: 第三季盈利按年增长 8%，因产量提高及下游销售增强。
公司于 2026 年 10 月至 11 月期间多次进行股份回购。
大股东 KWAP 和 EPF 在 11 月有多项持股变动申报。

news.title: Genting Plantations' Q3 earnings rise 8pct on higher production, stronger downstream sales

recent_en: Genting Plantations announced its quarterly results for the period ended 30 September 2026 on 25 November 2026, with Q3 earnings rising 8% year-on-year. The company has been continuously buying back shares and there were multiple substantial shareholder (KWAP, EPF) interest change announcements.
notable_en: Q3 earnings rose 8% year-on-year on higher production and stronger downstream sales.
Substantial shareholders KWAP and EPF filed multiple changes in interest in November.
